rung_purposes.purpose: Set motor overload alarm if overload healthy signal drops.
Reset generic fault latch via the fault reset pushbutton.
Aggregate overload, generic fault, and E-stop loss into a cell fault flag.
Run conveyor motor in auto mode if no cell faults are active.
Flag pallet in position when the stop photo-eye is blocked.
Latch stopper release solenoid on release request rising edge.
Run a 2.0s timer to track the stopper release duration.
Unlatch stopper release solenoid after duration timer completes.
